title: ISO 4406:2021 — Hydraulic fluid power — Fluids — Method for coding the level of contamination by solid particles
locator: Abstract and lifecycle: code used to define the quantity of solid particles in fluid used in a hydraulic fluid power system.
notes: Official page reports the 2021 edition was reviewed and confirmed in 2026. It defines a contamination coding method; it does not set a universal cleanliness target for all hydraulic components or machine tools.
